name: return-receipt
title: Return receipt and inspection record
for_each: select id,code from cases order by code

sections.title: Items
sections.sql: select code,sku,quantity,received,inspected,reason,requested from item_balance where case_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Receipts
sections.sql: select i.code,r.reference,r.quantity,r.received_on,r.note,r.actor from receipts r join items i on i.id=r.item_id where i.case_id=$1 order by r.received_on,i.code

sections.title: Inspection evidence
sections.sql: select i.code,x.quantity,x.grade,x.disposition,x.evidence,x.actor from inspections x join items i on i.id=x.item_id where i.case_id=$1 order by i.code,x.created_at

name: resolution-review
title: Remedy review and completion record
for_each: select id,code from cases order by code

sections.title: Items
sections.sql: select code,sku,quantity,received,inspected,reason,requested from item_balance where case_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Human assessment
sections.sql: select i.code,a.basis,a.severity,a.customer_choice,a.evidence,a.actor from assessments a join item_balance i on i.assessment_id=a.id where i.case_id=$1 order by i.code

sections.title: Remedy
sections.note: A decision is not proof of refund, exchange shipment or completed repair. External reference records the operator confirmation.
sections.sql: select i.code,r.remedy,r.amount_cents,c.currency,r.rationale,x.external_reference,x.note from resolutions r join items i on i.id=r.item_id join cases c on c.id=i.case_id left join completions x on x.resolution_id=r.id where c.id=$1 order by i.code

sections.title: Checks to review
sections.sql: select f.code,f.rule,f.finding from compliance_findings f join cases c on c.code=f.case_code where c.id=$1 order by f.code,f.rule
